question: Is there any dharma on earth comparable to the path of Kālī?
premises: No dharma is said to be equal to Kālī.
This absence of equal is stated for the earth.
inference: There is no dharma on earth equal to Kālī.
uncertainties: The second clause is elliptical, omitting an explicit noun parallel to dharmo.
plain_english: There is no dharma equal to Kālī, none equal to Kālī on earth.
